title: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yose ben Zimra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 27:5 and Kohelet Rabbah 3:15; Hyman says the reading should undoubtedly be “R′ Elazar [ר״א] in the name of R′ Yose ben Zimra,” for he said several things in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Midrash Rabbah — TE Vayikra Rabbah 27:5 names Rabbi Eliezer son of Rabbi Yose ben Zimra; Kohelet Rabbah 3:15 names Rabbi Elazar beRabbi Yose ben Zimra. These support the local full titles in the heading, while the differing Eliezer/Elazar forms are preserved. Hyman’s “undoubtedly should read” changes the relation to reporting in Yose ben Zimra’s name; its proposed personal titles remain R′, with his ר״א siglum visible. This is his forceful emendation and claim about other statements, not an adopted genealogical correction or a fresh count of the corpus.
